newsitem.title: USA: Evro holders OK common/preferred share rise.
newsitem.headline: Evro holders OK common/preferred share rise.

text.p: EVRO Corp said Tuesday its shareholders have authorized an increase of common stock from 2.5 million to 100 million shares and an increase in preferred stock from 1.25 million to 25 million shares, each with a par value of $0.001.
The company said its shareholders also approved changing the company name to Channel America Broadcasting Inc.

More authorized shares will assist in raising equity capital for the company's business plan and for consummating the acquisitions of the Sports & Shopping Network Inc and Channel America Television Network Inc, the company said.
